svg.text: Apple launch paths: macOS Terminal, iPhone/iPad in Safari, iPhone/iPad in iSH
Each box is what the shipped script really does. Where something can only be proven on your own device, the box says so instead of hiding it.
macOS: the Terminal you already have

g.text: No Homebrew, no pip, no download needed to start.
Launch Terminal (Spotlight, type "terminal"), then:
1 type cd and one space, then drag this folder
onto the window - it pastes its own path
2 press return, then run
sh 启动-macOS-Linux.sh
3 to move the port: PORT=9000 then the same
command; the page follows the port (§2.4)
What the script decides, in order
python3 present - bridge starts on 127.0.0.1,
the same-origin page opens, ⑧ is complete.
python3 absent - the offline page still opens,
and only ⑧'s hop-by-hop trace is missing.
The script then prints the single command that
fixes it: xcode-select --install
Command Line Tools ship /usr/bin/python3 -
no third-party package manager involved.
Double-clicking 启动-macOS.command instead
needs two one-time things: the execute bit
(chmod +x 启动-macOS.command) and
right-click - Open, because Gatekeeper stops a
downloaded .command (xattr -dr
com.apple.quarantine . clears the mark).
Using the Terminal skips both of those.
Proven from here / proven only on your Mac
Proven: shell logic, LF endings enforced by
.gitattributes, and the identical file set the
Linux CI job runs green (§8.8).
Author owns no Mac, so Gatekeeper's exact
wording and your python3 are yours to see -
the script prints which branch it took.
Zero install. This is the default answer.
Open the Pages URL (top of README and
MANUAL). Same bytes as the repository -
not a trimmed online demo.
Runs on the phone as-is
Seven kernels · offline city / land / country
data · map with the centre crosshair ·
⑪'s 623 gates · ①'s geolocation, because
https is a secure context.
Then switch the network off
Ten panels keep computing. The default map
is offline vector land, so it asks for no
tiles. Only the online-basemap switch and ⑧
ever send a request (§7.1).
The one thing a phone cannot do here
Hop-by-hop tracing needs python3 on the
device: a bridge bound to a LAN address is
refused at start-up on every platform
(§7.2.1), so "run the service on the laptop,
open 192.168.x.x from the sofa" is not a
path this tool will take - on purpose.
⑧ without any bridge at all
IP lookup against the six built-in sources
and DNS-over-HTTPS resolution still run,
straight from the browser; only the trace
row says "bridge offline".
Next step up: iSH, in the right-hand box.
Or on Android: Termux + pkg install python,
same idea, one bridge on the device.

svg.text: iPhone / iPad: iSH gives ⑧ a bridge

g.text: Four commands, then a printed Safari URL
1 install iSH (free, user-mode x86 Alpine)
2 apk add python3 (once)
3 get the project in: git clone --depth 1
https://github.com/IAMMEZSH/
geo-position-workstation
- or copy the folder into the Files app;
iSH mounts it under /mnt/
4 cd into it, then sh 启动-iSH.sh
The script prints four measured stages
1 python3 server.py --selftest - the count
it prints is the bridge's own verdict
2 start the bridge, poll /api/health for
15 s, and stop early if it dies
3 print real API values: server, version,
runtime, bind address, loopback_only=true,
interface count and its redacted fields
4 print the URL to tap, plus the diagnosis
list for "Safari shows nothing"
The boundary, stated in the script itself
iOS suspends iSH once iSH leaves the
foreground, and the bridge sleeps with it.
iPad: keep iSH in Split View or Slide Over
beside Safari. iPhone: no Split View, so
expect to re-tap and re-run the trace.
Whether Safari reaches iSH's loopback port
is printed by stages 2-4 on your device.
The author owns no iOS hardware; community
reports say it works while iSH keeps running.
If it does not: the left-hand hosted page,
with GeoIP and DoH, is still a full tool -
and nothing here loosens the loopback rule.

svg.text: Two failures that look like broken software and are not

g.text: · Files app, double-tap the .html: Quick Look draws a preview and never executes JavaScript, so the page seems dead.
Use Safari - or a browser on any other platform - never the Files preview. Nothing is wrong with the files themselves.
· "Let the phone reach the laptop's bridge" by binding 0.0.0.0: both bridges refuse a non-loopback bind at start-up
and exit with the reason (§7.2.1, §9.2). Run the bridge on the device instead - Termux on Android, iSH on iOS.
That is why the iSH script prints a banner for every stage: "Safari shows nothing" should come back as a named stage that failed, not a mystery.
